questions.question: Create a sentence using the word “outweigh.”
answer: The long-term benefits of regular exercise outweigh the temporary discomfort of waking up early.

questions.question: Create a sentence using the word “critics.”
answer: Critics of the new policy argue that it may increase school expenses.

questions.question: Create a sentence using the word “interactive.”
answer: The science exhibition was interactive because students could conduct simple experiments themselves.

questions.question:
Write an essay of about 150-200 words on the topic below.
Remember to include:
  • A claim (your main argument).
  • At least one counterclaim (the opposite view).
  • A refutation (explain why the counterclaim is weaker than your claim).
  • A clear introduction, body, and conclusion.
Topic: Should there be fixed play hours for kids aged 8-10?
